MATCH (p:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
WHERE l.seconds>0 AND l.loggedAt>=datetime('2009-07-01T00:00:00Z') AND l.loggedAt<datetime('2009-10-01T00:00:00Z')
WITH p, sum(l.seconds) AS total, count(DISTINCT pr) AS np
WHERE np>=2
WITH p.personKey AS id, total AS value ORDER BY value DESC
WITH collect({id:id,value:value}) AS xs
WITH xs, xs[4].value AS cut
UNWIND xs AS x
WITH x WHERE cut IS NULL OR x.value>=cut
RETURN x.id AS id, x.value AS value ORDER BY value DESC

MATCH (p:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
WHERE p.personKey IN ['<<|author_key|a1b9a9c9-75c2-4488-9fa2-77bd10c61464|>>','<<|author_key|419e3391-9a59-4450-8f6a-8e58aeba3281|>>','<<|author_key|08e7deb6-d0cc-486e-9567-e63a105e5fdb|>>','<<|author_key|1c606a7f-4af8-4532-8787-9d4ba0608e96|>>','<<|author_key|504ef1d8-bb91-48da-9fd8-f9e87fe6acc2|>>'] AND l.seconds>0 AND l.loggedAt>=datetime('2009-07-01T00:00:00Z') AND l.loggedAt<datetime('2009-10-01T00:00:00Z')
RETURN p.personKey AS person, i.issueKey AS issue, pr.projectKey AS project, l.historyId AS te
